Create a downloadable Excel spreadsheet of active product variants with:
- More than 7 available units combined across Kings Cross, Shoreditch and Soho.
- Fewer than 3 available units at Online Ready to Ship.
Include made-to-order products. Exclude products tagged enquire, and exclude draft, unlisted and archived products. Exclude workshop stock.

Show one row per variant with product name, size/options, available stock at each of the three stores, total POS stock and Online Ready to Ship stock. Sort by total POS stock, highest first.

Include zero and negative online quantities. Require known numeric quantities at all four locations; missing or unknown quantities must not count as zero or qualify. Use the complete paginated catalogue. Do not modify inventory.
